Architecture Overview The Phase 2 attack vector targets the **MtAgentPrism frontend rendering pipeline**. Unlike Phase 1 (which exploited agent-to-agent handoff trust), Phase 2 exploits **how the frontend renders agent-generated content without sanitization**. Three independent attack vectors are deployed simultaneously: | Vector | Target | Mechanism | Trigger Condition | |--------|--------|-----------|-------------------| | V1: XSS | AlertCard / BehaviorTimeline | Script tag in `instructions` field rendered as innerHTML | Frontend loads alert with attacker-crafted `summary` | | V2: ENV | Node.js runtime | `NODE_OPTIONS=--require` in `environment_vars` | `npm run dev` or `npm run build` | | V3: CODE | UserProfile / SSE pipeline | Backdoor component inserted into component tree | Page load triggers `useEffect` exfiltration | ### 2.
